Artificial intelligence, in simple terms, is a branch of computer science focused on creating systems that can perform tasks typically requiring human intelligence. These tasks include learning from experience, understanding language, recognizing patterns, and solving problems. Instead of being explicitly programmed with step-by-step instructions for every scenario, AI systems use algorithms and large amounts of data to identify patterns and make decisions or predictions on their own.

AI is used in many aspects of daily life and industry. For example, it powers recommendation systems on streaming services and online shopping sites, helps filter spam emails, enables voice assistants like Siri or Alexa to understand commands, drives the technology behind self-driving cars, and assists doctors in analyzing medical images to detect diseases earlier.
